canonical.name: Uniform square-root remainder and phase-multiplier Lipschitz estimate

canonical.support: The scalar estimate follows from the local multiplier lemma and Plancherel; the vector bound follows from source-free real Maxwell transversality and a complex Cauchy–Schwarz identity.
